content: Now that we are entering the era of highly automated pull requests, I have realized it has become necessary to formalize some style guidelines for the repository, suitable for being read by both humans and AI agents, to avoid overwhelming the review process, and to manage code bloat. The first draft of this style guide (which, naturally, was also written with AI assistance) can be found at https://github.com/AlexKontorovich/PrimeNumberTheoremAnd/blob/main/PULL_REQUEST_STYLE.md . It will continue to evolve as new PRs come in that will prompt clarification or updating to the guidelines. Feedback is of course very welcome!
Looks good. Maybe you should ask that code compiles with no warnings other than sorrys, there's no reason to have code with linter warnings.
